# Configuration

Everything is an environment variable. Only `NAVIDROME_URL` usually needs setting. A bad value stops the server at
boot with a message naming the variable.

<!-- generated by `bun scripts/config-docs.ts` from src/server/settings.ts; don't edit by hand -->

| variable | default | what |
|---|---|---|
| `NAVIDROME_URL` | `http://navidrome:4533` | Your Navidrome (or any OpenSubsonic server), as this container reaches it. Usually the internal Docker address. |
| `NAVIDROME_SERVERS` | — | Several servers to choose from at sign-in, as `id=url` pairs separated by commas (`home=http://navidrome:4533,friend=https://music.example.com`). Replaces `NAVIDROME_URL`. The browser can only ever pick from this list. |
| `PORT` | `8080` | Port the server listens on. |
| `DATA_DIR` | `./data` | Where sessions, the search and lyrics index, history and the cover cache live. Mount a volume here (`/data` in the image). |
| `SESSION_SECRET` | — | Encrypts stored Navidrome credentials. Unset: a random one is generated once and kept in `DATA_DIR`. |
| `SESSION_IDLE_DAYS` | `30` | A browser that isn't used for this long is signed out. |
| `COVER_CACHE_MB` | `1024` | Disk for resized covers; least recently used are deleted first. |
| `LRCLIB_URL` | `https://lrclib.net` | Where lyrics Navidrome doesn't have are looked up. Empty turns LRCLIB off. |
| `LYRICS_BACKFILL` | `on` | `on`: walk the library in the background (about one song a second) to fetch lyrics nobody opened yet. `off` to disable. |
| `LYRICS_WRITE_LRC` | `off` | `on`: lyrics found on LRCLIB are also saved as `<track>.lrc` next to the audio file, so other clients get them. Needs `MUSIC_DIR` and Navidrome's "Report Real Path". Never overwrites; undo from the lyrics page. |
| `MUSIC_DIR` | — | Navidrome's music folder mounted writable here, for `LYRICS_WRITE_LRC`. Unused otherwise. |
| `INDEX_USER` | — | Navidrome account for background jobs (search index, lyrics backfill). Unset: the admin who signed in most recently. |
| `INDEX_PASSWORD` | — | Password for `INDEX_USER`. |
| `TRUST_PROXY` | `false` | `true` behind a reverse proxy: client IPs come from `X-Real-IP` / `X-Forwarded-For` (login rate limits). |
| `UPDATE_CHECK` | `off` | `on`: admins see when a newer release is out (one request to GitHub a day). Nothing else is ever sent anywhere. |
